summary.intent: Get a status report on the callisto repo (local git state, PRs, plans, Entire history), then move on to landing the unpushed v1 work (T01-T05/T11) as a clean stack.
summary.outcome: Produced a full status report and agreed on a 5-layer stack by crate (model, manifests, graph, cli, docs/changesets). Started committing the code layers by explicit path, leaving the Entire/Claude/Gemini settings edits out; only the manifests-layer files are confirmed modified so far, and nothing has been pushed.

repo: Branch work/v1-implementation-stack is 4 local commits ahead of origin/main with no PR; the dirty tree has 83 files (~7.6k lines added) plus untracked changesets and V1 docs.
Cargo.lock +368 lines (36 new packages) comes from the new jsonschema = "0.53" dev-dependency in callisto-cli, used by the JSON-schema tests, so it is fine to commit.

version.rs, release.rs, lib.rs, runner.rs, cascade.rs and the CLI e2e test files carry hunks from several of the 10 changesets, so a per-topic commit split would need hunk-level patch surgery and a build after each commit.
docs/projects/ROAD-TO-V1.md is stale: its baseline still reads 8ef9aa5a4 / 'awaiting merge', and Stage 1 is moot since 0.9.0 and 0.10.0 shipped.

V1-VERIFICATION.md records component-wise checks passing on Sep 28 (1,862 tests, Clippy, 93.45% coverage, 25 release-workflow cases), but aggregate `just ci` hit a sandbox lock in cargo-deny and was never green as one run.
workflow: Dirty trees can hold tool-config edits that must not be committed: .entire/settings.json flipped push_sessions/push_checkpoints to true on a public repo, which conflicts with the user's rule that session transcripts stay private.
Stage by explicit path rather than `git add -A` when the tree mixes feature work with tool-settings changes.
When topic splits aren't cleanly separable by file, a layered stack by crate with `cargo check` per layer and full `just ci` on the tip is a cheaper way to keep each commit buildable.
Confirm with the user before pushing; the plan is to push only after confirmation.

friction: Local commit T01 may overlap with merged #170, which fixed the same verify step on main; this was not checked before the report.
Aggregate `just ci` could not run green as one invocation because of a sandbox lock in cargo-deny.
Dirty tree mixes v1 work with unrelated tooling edits (.claude/settings.json SubagentStop hook, .gemini/settings.json with 136 lines deleted, .entire/settings.json), which complicates staging.
Entire reports Claude hooks out of date and one legacy shadow branch, so the tooling needs maintenance.
open_items: Finish the remaining stack layers: graph, cli (with Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock and action scripts), then docs/changesets/specs/verification docs.
Rebase onto current origin/main and resolve the overlap between local T01 and #170.
Run `cargo check` per layer and full `just ci` on the tip, then push as a native `gh stack` after user confirmation.
Merge dependabot PR #175 (taiki-e/install-action), which has all 11 checks passing.
Refresh ROAD-TO-V1.md baseline and Stage 1 status.
Stages 3-5 not started: D01 owner-contract checkpoint, T06-T09 model changes, T10 generated workflows, T12 onboarding integration.

Clean up loose ends: Sep 27 stash 'Callisto v1 work before origin/main sync', 174 Entire checkpoints not on origin, `entire enable --force` and `entire doctor`, and stale origin branches (fix/native-resolution, fix/release-forge-lookup, fix/release-pr-verify-envelope, docs/spec-rewrite).
Decide what to do with the excluded tool-settings edits (.entire, .claude, .gemini) left in the working tree.
